title: Nigel Splashforth Is Now a Cloud Run Job

paragraphs: I built a Claude Code plugin that handles all Instagram content for The Paddle Games. Three skills: feature-carousel generates multi-slide app launch carousels from source code. location-carousel announces new routes and badges for a paddle spot with live data and a Mapbox mockup. leaderboard-roast is the one I ended up automating.

The roast started as a bit. I was looking at the monthly standings and the founder (me) was sitting somewhere embarrassing on his own leaderboard. So I gave the commentary job to Nigel Splashforth, British sports correspondent, and wrote a skill that reads Firestore and renders a 1080x1080 PNG card.
Nigel ran manually for a while. Then I wired him to a Cloud Run Job: monthly recap on the 1st, plus an hourly live mode that handles "Roast now" taps from inside the app.
Anyone building recurring AI-generated content for a product — how do you handle the review step before it goes public?
